newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas signs tennis player Henman to new contract.
newsitem.headline: Adidas signs tennis player Henman to new contract.

text.p: German sportswear group Adidas AG said on Friday it has signed a new endorsement contract with British tennis player Tim Henman.
Henman, aged 22, is currently ranked No. 20 in the world. He has been using Adidas footwear and apparel since age 19.
Adidas said the new partnership would last into the next century.

Henman reached the finals of the Qatar Open this year and won the Sydney International tournament. He is also the British hopeful for the upcoming Wimbledon tournament where he will wear his new Adidas kit for the first time.
